label: Research field
datacite_4_7: subjects (subjectScheme 'Fields of Science and Technology (FOS)', e.g. 'FOS: Educational sciences')

label: Theoretical framework
datacite_4_7: subjects (subjectScheme 'HuMeta Frameworks', valueURI per framework); descriptions (Methods)

label: Constructs measured
datacite_4_7: subjects (subjectScheme 'HuMeta Constructs', valueURI per construct); for datasets, relatedIdentifiers to the instrument's library record (URL, relationType IsCollectedBy) and its publication (DOI, relationType References); ERIC descriptors as additional subjects

label: Discipline or subject area
datacite_4_7: subjects (subjectScheme 'HuMeta Disciplines'; plus 'Fields of Science and Technology (FOS)' with each term's FOS code)

label: Education level
datacite_4_7: subjects (subjectScheme 'HuMeta Education Levels'); ISCED 2011 level as an additional subject (subjectScheme 'ISCED 2011')
